create_implicit_exact_curvature: create an ImplicitExactCurvature instance from a model function to compute exact curvature matrices implicitly
run_multiply_hessian: run multiply_hessian to compute the Hessian-vector product of the total loss without constructing the matrix explicitly
run_multiply_fisher: run multiply_fisher to compute the Fisher matrix-vector product for NegativeLogProbLoss functions
run_multiply_ggn: run multiply_ggn to compute the Gauss-Newton matrix-vector product of the total loss
run_multiply_jacobian_transpose: run multiply_jacobian_transpose to compute the transposed Jacobian-vector product for VJP-based curvature operations
